known_limitations: Uses in-memory storage only; data is not persisted across restarts.
Implements a focused subset of the reviewed requirements: login, basic family/child/invoice workflows, simple audit logging, and invoice export.
Does not implement full role administration, advanced concurrency handling, archival workflows, imports, notifications, accessibility enhancements, or external integrations.
Does not yet enforce detailed record-level access rules, MFA, or session timeout behavior.
